# EnterpriseGlue v0.40.6 Release Notes

Generated from release-note fragments changed since `v0.40.5`.

## Highlights

- **dashboard:** Starts project and file totals earlier on workspace reload and reduces duplicate database reads during permission loading.

## User and administrator impact

- Project and file totals can appear sooner while the rest of the dashboard loads.

## Database migrations

- Database rollback supported for the combined release: yes.

## Security

- Permission lookups are reused within the same authenticated request. Dashboard reads still require a verified organization session and permission.

## Documentation

- The dashboard uses the existing tenant-scoped project statistics endpoint.

## Rollback

- Redeploy the previous compatible application images.

## Validation evidence

- Permission snapshot and browser tests cover request-local lookup reuse and progressive dashboard loading.
